preconditions.description: Input must contain exactly two integers n (number of cities) and m (number of flights) where 2 ≤ n ≤ 1000 and 1 ≤ m ≤ 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and 1 <= int(line.split()[0]) < int(line.split()[1]) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each flight is a one-directional edge from city ai to city bi where 1 ≤ ai < bi ≤ n, and no two flights share the same pair of cities.

preconditions.expression: any(all(1 <= a < b <= n for a, b in flights) for flights in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: There exists at least one path from city 1 to city n using the given flights.

preconditions.expression: not any((a, b) in [(int(x.split()[0]), int(x.split()[1])) for x in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] for a, b in [(int(x.split()[0]), int(x.split()[1])) for x in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if a != b)
preconditions.description: No two flights are between the same pair of cities (no duplicate edges).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'No' or (stdout.strip() == 'Yes' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == m + 1 and all(1 <= int(x) <= 2 for x in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no valid assignment exists, output 'No'. Otherwise, output 'Yes' followed by m integers (1 or 2) representing flight durations in the same order as input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' and all(len(line.split()) == 1 and line.strip() in ['1', '2'] for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: If a valid assignment exists, each flight duration must be either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' and (lambda: all(calculate_path_length(1, n, flights_with_durations) == calculate_path_length(1, n, flights_with_durations, path) for path in get_all_paths(1, n, flights)))(flights_with_durations)
postconditions.description: If a valid assignment exists, all paths from city 1 to city n must have the same total duration, where flights_with_durations is the list of flights with their assigned durations.
